add.text: Two Unity Pro seats for three years at unchanged prepaid prices of $2,310 per seat per year cost about $13,860.
add.label: agreed but unchecked

add.text: Unity LevelPlay officially supports ad mediation with major networks, including AdMob and AppLovin.
add.label: verified

add.text: The Godot Foundation maintains and is improving the core Google Play Billing and StoreKit 2 in-app purchase plugins for Godot.
add.label: verified

add.text: For a two-person mobile team with equal experience in Unity and Godot, Unity likely has the lower risk-adjusted three-year total cost, but this is an engineering judgment about integration labour rather than a measured result.
add.label: agreed but unchecked

change.text: Under Unity's 2026 pricing, Unity Personal is free while the company's total annual revenue plus funding stays under $200,000, which is not a per-game threshold, and Unity Pro costs $2,310 per seat per year when prepaid.
change.label: verified
change.reason: The new run's checked Unity page shows the threshold counts total company revenue plus funding rather than per-game revenue.

open_disputes.text: Whether Godot has no official ad mediation and relies only on community plugins or custom native bridges remains disputed.

resolve_disputes.resolution: The Unity side is settled: LevelPlay officially mediates major ad networks such as AdMob and AppLovin, which is verified. The Godot side is still disputed and is carried forward as a new open dispute.
